title: [Bug] Replay buffer is not thread-safe for concurrent extend() + sample()
author: vmoens

comments.author: erfanBohloul
comments.body:
Hi @vmoens,
I'm looking into this issue as a first time contributor. is this issue still open?
I tried to reproduce the problem on CPU. I used a script very close to the example. I removed the time.sleep from the writer loop to maximize thread contention. I ran the test up to 200_000 iterations.
I tested on three environments: MacOS M2 (python 3.14), Ubuntu 24 (python 3.12) and kaggle notebook. I used torchrl 0.11.1 everywhere. 
Unfortunately, I was unable to trigger any visible data corruption, page faults, or crashes across dozens of runs.
Did anyone manage to see the bug happen more easily? Or maybe a fix is already in progress in a newer commit?

comments.author: vmoens
comments.body:
Hello! Could be that it's safe after all!
Thanks for wanting to help, if you're looking for ideas please let me know!
